name: cas-ngs/act3-process-timeline
title: Act 3: Process Timeline
description: 4-stage biotech sequencing pipeline (Sample Prep → Nanopore Basecalling → Computational Analysis → Research Insight) with QC badges.

section_title.default: From Biological Sample to Scientific Insight

section_desc.default: A seamless four-stage trajectory engineered to deliver maximum data integrity, zero amplification artifact, and actionable results.

phase1_desc.default: HMW DNA/RNA extraction with strict fragment length selection (>50 kb). Fluorometric Qubit QC and agarose gel integrity verification.

phase2_desc.default: Single-molecule translocation through synthetic protein pores at 400 bp/s. Direct electronic voltage sampling at 4,000 measurements/sec per channel.

phase3_desc.default: Raw ionic current squiggles translated via Dorado SUP neural models. Structural variant calling (Sniffles2), chromosomal phasing, and methylation profiling.

phase4_desc.default: Publication-ready methylation heatmaps, de novo assembly graphs, chromosomal phasing, and full raw POD5 / FASTQ + BAM + VCF delivery packages.
